faqs.question: How much is one roll?
faqs.answer: XPRINT thermal rolls are KES 165 per roll. Tell us the size and how many rolls you need when you message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How do I know which size my printer takes?
faqs.answer: Check the paper width printed on the printer or in its manual, and the largest roll diameter its paper bay can hold. Sizes are written as width x outer diameter in millimetres. If you're unsure, send us your printer model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: How should I store thermal rolls?
faqs.answer: Keep them in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat. Thermal paper darkens when it gets hot, which makes the printing fade or turn the paper dark.

faqs.question: How fast can I get them?
faqs.answer: We deliver the same day in Nairobi and within 1–2 days upcountry.
